title: Customer Story
message:
HELP US SOURCE LOCALLY 🌿

Hindi na sustainable ang pag-ubos ng tanglad ng mga kakilala namin.😭

We’re hoping to find a reliable, preferably local tanglad supplier who can provide fresh supply 4 times a week.

If you grow or supply (native) tanglad, or know someone who does, we’d love to hear from you.

Message us for details or referrals. 🙏🏻💙
